Hey everyone! I’m Ahmed, a Computer Science undergrad specializing in backend architecture, data automation, and AI integrations.

I’m locked in on the Harmonization of MODIS & VIIRS Hot Spots challenge! If we team up, I guarantee a rock-solid backend for a killer live demo.

No specific tech stack required! If you’re insanely passionate, ready to hustle, and want to crush the frontend, data, or our final pitch, you belong here. Let’s build something epic! Beginners are more than welcome!
